report_name: Gyazo Data Breach Exposes 23.6M User Records

attack_patterns.name: Exploit Public-Facing Application
attack_patterns.description: An attacker exploited an unspecified vulnerability in Gyazo's public-facing image upload server to gain initial access and achieve remote code execution.

attack_patterns.name: OS Credential Dumping
attack_patterns.description: The attacker accessed and exfiltrated user credentials, including salted and hashed passwords, from the backend database after gaining initial access.

attack_patterns.name: Data from Cloud Storage
attack_patterns.description: The attacker exfiltrated 23.62 million user records and metadata for 490 million images from Gyazo's backend database.

vulnerabilities.name: Unspecified Gyazo Image Upload Server Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: An unspecified vulnerability in Gyazo's public-facing image upload server was exploited by an attacker to achieve remote code execution, which was used to pivot and access a backend database.

campaigns.name: Gyazo Data Breach September 2026
campaigns.description: An unnamed attacker exploited a vulnerability in Gyazo's image upload server to exfiltrate 23.62 million user records and metadata for 490 million images in September 2026.

identities.name: Helpfeel Inc.
identities.description: The parent company of Gyazo that disclosed the data breach and is managing the incident response.

identities.name: Gyazo
identities.description: An image-sharing service that was the primary victim of a data breach, resulting in the exposure of 23.62 million user records and metadata for 490 million images.

identities.name: Google
identities.description: Mentioned as a Single Sign-On (SSO) provider for Gyazo users, whose email addresses were exposed in the breach.

identities.name: X (Twitter)
identities.description: Social media platform for which user integration tokens were compromised in the Gyazo data breach, potentially allowing for unauthorized API activity.

identities.name: Personal Information Protection Commission
identities.description: Japan's data protection authority to which Helpfeel reported the data breach.

infrastructure.name: Compromised Gyazo Image Upload Server
infrastructure.description: A public-facing image upload server belonging to Gyazo that was exploited by an attacker to gain initial access and pivot to the backend database.

indicators.name: Gyazo Domain Monitoring for Data Leakage
indicators.x_netsecio_sigma_rule:
title: Gyazo Domain DNS Query
id: 2b8c1f3a-7d4e-4b9f-8c1d-9e2a3b4c5d6e
status: experimental
description: Monitors for DNS queries to gyazo.com, which could be relevant for tracking user activity or potential data leakage in the context of the 2026 data breach.
references:
  - https://www.teiss.co.uk/news/gyazo-data-breach-exposed-millions-of-records-company-delayed-public-disclosure-18180
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-09-18
level: informational
logsource:
  category: dns_query
detection:
  selection:
    QueryName|endswith: '.gyazo.com'
  condition: selection
indicators.description: Monitors for DNS queries to gyazo.com, which could be relevant for tracking user activity or potential data leakage in the context of the 2026 data breach.

indicators.name: Twitter API Monitoring for Leaked Token Abuse
indicators.x_netsecio_sigma_rule:
title: Twitter API Network Connection
id: 8f9a0b1c-2d3e-4f5a-6b7c-8d9e0f1a2b3c
status: experimental
description: Monitors for network connections to api.twitter.com. In the context of the Gyazo breach, a spike in unusual activity could indicate abuse of leaked X (Twitter) integration tokens.
references:
  - https://www.teiss.co.uk/news/gyazo-data-breach-exposed-millions-of-records-company-delayed-public-disclosure-18180
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-09-18
level: medium
logsource:
  category: proxy
detection:
  selection:
    cs-host: 'api.twitter.com'
  condition: selection
indicators.description: Monitors for network connections to api.twitter.com. In the context of the Gyazo breach, a spike in unusual activity could indicate abuse of leaked X (Twitter) integration tokens.
